guide.text: Increases HP, Attack, and Crit Damage. Superman's Attack bonus stacks with each Ultimate cast, and higher base Attack means a bigger boost. With the Crit Damage bonus, his single-target burst becomes even more devastating.

Increases HP, Attack, and Crit Damage. Harley Quinn relies on high Attack to maximize damage from her Ultimate and enhanced state, while the HP bonus improves her survivability and the Crit Damage bonus further boosts her damage output.
Provides Attack and Crit Rate bonuses, helping Batman deal more damage and trigger his smoke bomb's Attack debuff more often with critical hits.

Increases HP, Attack, and Crit Damage. Catwoman grows stronger by stealing enemy Attack, so a higher Attack makes her steals even more threatening, and the Crit Damage bonus fits her DPS role perfectly.
Hawkgirl's [Nth Metal Aegis] scales with her Max HP, so this weapon improves how much damage the Aegis can absorb.
Increases HP, Attack, and Crit Damage. Supergirl's Ultimate damage scales with Krypton Energy, and higher base Attack and Crit Damage make her AoE burst far more devastating.
Increases HP, Attack, and Crit Damage. Atom stacks up Attack with basic attacks. Higher Attack means bigger stacks, and more Crit Damage makes his finishing move hit even harder.

Provides a well-rounded boost to HP, Attack, and Crit Damage. Cassandra Cain excels at explosive crit bursts, and the high Attack and Crit Damage bonuses greatly amplify both her dodge-triggered slashes and chained crit damage.
Balances offense and defense, letting Batman keep up his smoke bomb pressure without leaving him exposed. A versatile choice across multiple modes.
Balances damage and survivability, allowing Harley Quinn to dive in, finish enemies up close, and survive counterattacks from multiple targets during [Self-Actualization].
Provides HP, Attack, and Crit Damage bonuses, giving Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow useful boosts in both forms: stronger healing before she transforms and stronger physical damage afterward.
Provides a balanced mix of Attack, Crit Damage, and survivability.
Boosts Robin's overall combat performance, helping him enter [Afterimage] reliably and maintain steady single-target damage.
